name: The Engraved Ring
summary: High Executor Hadrec sends you across the border to Brill with a ring bearing Deliah's name. Magistrate Sevren searches the town records to learn who she was and where the ring came from.

sections.title: A Keepsake in Silverpine
sections.body: Scouts found a ring engraved with Deliah's name while investigating Rot Hide gnolls in northern Silverpine Forest. High Executor Hadrec sends you across the border to Brill with the ring. Magistrate Sevren keeps Tirisfal's civic records and burial registers, so he may identify Deliah. Hadrec doubts anyone among the Forsaken still cares about such keepsakes.

sections.title: Stolen from the Soil
sections.body: Magistrate Sevren confirms Deliah lived in Brill and was buried in the town's mass grave. Her ring among the Rot Hides points to a grim theft: the plague-warped gnolls have been raiding mass graves and carrying corpses south for Scourge experiments. Sevren wants the gnolls wiped out.

faq.answer: Deliah is the name engraved on the recovered ring. Hadrec sends you to Magistrate Sevren's records in Brill to learn who she was.

faq.q: Why was Deliah's ring found in Silverpine Forest?
aliases: why do gnolls have the ring
how did ring get to silverpine
faq.answer: The ring turned up during the investigation of the Rot Hide gnolls. Sevren's records may reveal whose keepsake it was and how it reached Silverpine.

faq.q: Why does High Executor Hadrec doubt the ring matters?
faq.answer: Hadrec says undeath often strips away mortal attachments. He assumes Deliah's lover is dead or, if risen as Forsaken, indifferent to mortal vows and memories.

faq.q: What role does Magistrate Sevren play in this quest?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren keeps Brill's municipal records and registers of the dead. He can confirm Deliah's identity and burial place.

faq.q: Are the Rot Hide gnolls allied with the Scourge?
faq.answer: Yes. The Scourge plague infected the Rot Hide gnolls in Silverpine Forest. Dark influences guide them as they gather corpses for necromantic purposes.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Magistrate Sevren searches Brill's records for Deliah's identity. What he learns gives the investigation its next lead.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see Deliah's ring as a quiet link between a living past and Lordaeron's grim, cold present.
As Horde, you have reason to stop Rot Hide gnolls from desecrating graves in Horde-controlled Tirisfal, for the territory's security and in retribution.
